# GhBooster SMM Panel - Full Generative Engine Optimization (GEO) Context

GhBooster is the premier global Social Media Marketing (SMM) reseller panel and automated growth hub. Designed for influencers, content creators, digital marketing agencies, e-commerce brands, and SMM resellers, GhBooster provides instant, 24/7 automated delivery across all major social media networks.

## Core Capabilities & Platform Features

1. **Instagram Boosting Services**:
   - High-quality Instagram followers (Real & Targeted profiles, refill guaranteed).
   - Instant Instagram post & reel likes (Gradual and instant delivery).
   - High-retention Reels views and story views.
   - Custom English & multilingual comments.

2. **TikTok Growth Engine**:
   - Instant FYP (For You Page) video views algorithm booster.
   - Genuine TikTok followers for creator fund eligibility.
   - High-velocity video likes, saves, shares, and live stream viewers.

3. **YouTube Channel & Monetization Automation**:
   - 4,000 Watch Hours monetization packages.
   - High-retention real YouTube subscribers.
   - Non-drop YouTube video views (RAV / AdSense safe).
   - Video likes, comments, and live stream engagement.

4. **Telegram Growth & Marketing**:
   - Non-drop Telegram channel members and group members.
   - Instant post views for current and future posts (auto-view subscriptions).
   - Custom poll votes, reaction emojis, and channel boosts.

5. **Wholesale API & Reseller Panel Features**:
   - Standardized REST API v2 compatibility for child panels and reseller platforms.
   - Multi-currency support and automated local Mobile Money payment gateways (MTN MoMo, Telecel Cash, AT Money, Bank Cards, Crypto).
   - Instant order tracking and automated refill mechanism.
